title: Paint hop study
status: proposed poses and timing only; not a source animation

cues: cocoa face window and two broad pale arch eyes
orange crown stripe, boots, and one seed chest mark
compact cream torso and attached thick mittens

renderer.name: drawSower(ctx, pose)
renderer.implementation: Fixed Canvas 2D paths rendered at half resolution and nearest-neighbor upscaled; joint rotations, root translation and rotation
invariants: Head, torso, limbs, and face use the same paths for all six poses.
No body-part scaling or pose-specific anatomy redraws.
The ground marks remain in fixed scene coordinates.
Frames are rendered offscreen at 180 by 180 and enlarged 2x with image smoothing disabled.
Paused playback returns without scheduling another animation frame.

timingProposal.cycleMeaning: Nominal cycle only; delayed animation frames can extend the actual time.

poses.name: Crouch
poses.pose: Planted boots, flexed knees, arms poised forward.

poses.name: Push
poses.pose: The root rises slightly as the legs extend.

poses.name: Ascent
poses.pose: Both boots leave the ground; arms and legs trail.

poses.name: Apex
poses.pose: Highest root position with an asymmetric follow-through.

poses.name: Landing
poses.pose: Boots return with bent knees and short impact cues.

controls.scrub: six discrete positions; scrubbing pauses playback
controls.reducedMotion: prefers-reduced-motion opens on a paused crouch

referencePins.role: Balanced character family and compact torso comparison; design cue only.
Prior hop proposal reviewed for continuity; geometry and poses redrawn in code.
Preference anchor; palette, hood, face, and single seed chest cue.

verification.liveSlider: six distinct key poses inspected in order
verification.playPause: pause state observed; subsequent scrubbed pose remained static
verification.renderer: public copy loaded at /sowers/prototypes/paint-hop/index.html; six frames rendered and sheet exported from its half-resolution Canvas 2D renderer
verification.mobileFit: Coordinator browser verified390px; no horizontal overflow.

verification.pageErrors: Coordinator instrumented pageerror during playback and six-pose scrubbing on public and source routes; none observed.

limitations: This is a pose and timing proposal, not observed source animation.
Final character proportions and manufacturing properties are not established.
